scope: Radio-off component checks on ESP32-S3, not a full or continuous receiver
limitations: Filter uses a new 32-tap response; no RF/blocker or payload qualification
FEC uses synthetic LLRs, not captured RF words
Work cycles include interrupt/cache cost, exclude deliberate task delays
FEC total includes init, iteration work, sign packing, all full checks and extraction recheck
No concurrent sample ingestion, acquisition or carrier tracking in this benchmark
Filter timing reuses 1 KB of SC8 input and small Q6 output buffers; cold full-record memory traffic is unmeasured

packed_clean.scope: Paired radio-off component comparison, synthetic MC6 LLRs; PSRAM packed input/output, no live capture or carrier
packed_clean.filter_gate: At least20percent wholefilter reduction; candidate correct but failed performance gate

blocked_correction.scope: Radio-off synthetic0/9/80wrong-signLLRs; no continuousRX; repaired-word repack included only in whole work field

carrier_and_parity.scope: Radio-off public Q32 carrier estimation, rotation, Gold descrambling, LLR/sign packing and MC6 validation. Filtering, capture, acquisition and live queues excluded.

interruptible_collector.scope: Quiet native16MS collector to4MS halfbands and fixed1MS matched-filter consumer, no acquisition/carrier/FEC
interruptible_collector.context_policy: Full QR/QACC/ACCX/SAR/SAR_BYTE/CPENABLE preservation; exclude only ISA-defined PS.CALLINC/OWB ABI bookkeeping, retaining original strict failures.

reports.scaling: two Q15 halfbands, valid windows, signed10 to sc8

reports.scope: Wall cycles include ISR/preemption. Transfer ends at EOF callback; completion includes idle/owner/length/cache checks.

reports.max_mask_cycles_scope: wrapper elapsed includes possible post-unmask ISR/preemption

reports.scope: pre-ADC controls; excluded from stream timing
post-preflight reader loop through final guards before notification; work excludes bracketed vTaskDelay elapsed and includes ISR/preemption
